nodes.statement: To begin, for each $1 \leq \ell \leq k+1$ and $\tau_{\geq \ell} \in \{0, 1\}^{k - \ell + 1}$, we define the matrix \begin{equation} S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} = \sum_{\tau_{< \ell} : |\tau| \geq d+1} G^{|\tau_{<\ell}|}\cdot (I-G)^{(\ell-1)-|\tau_{<\ell}|}. \end{equation}

nodes.name: Rewrite the inequality with S
nodes.statement: Then the statement in \Cref{eq:i-think-this-is-what-i'm-supposed-to-prove} can be rewritten as \begin{align} &\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{g_{\geq \ell} \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}}_{g_{\geq \ell}} \otimes S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}\ket{\psi}\nonumber\\ \approx_{2\sqrt{2\zeta} + 2 \sqrt{\nu_4}}~&\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{>\ell}} \sum_{g_{>\ell} \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{> \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}} \otimes S_{\tau_{>\ell}} \ket{\psi}. \end{align}

nodes.name: List the facts needed
nodes.statement: To prove this, we will use several facts about $S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}$.

nodes.name: S is PSD
nodes.statement: First, $S$ is Hermitian and positive semidefinite. This is because each term in \Cref{eq:S-def} is a product of~$G$ and $(I-G)$. These matrices commute with each other, and both are Hermitian and positive semidefinite.

nodes.name: S <= I
Average of G-hat outcomes of a type
nodes.statement: In addition, for any $\tau_{\ell} \in \{0, 1\}$, \begin{align} \Big(\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}} \sum_{g_{\ell} \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\ell}}} \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}}\Big) & = \left\{ \begin{array}{cl} G & \text{if } \tau_{\ell} = 1,\\ (I-G) & \text{if } \tau_{\ell} = 0, \end{array}\right.\nonumber\\ &= G^{\tau_{\ell}} \cdot (I - G)^{1 - \tau_{\ell}}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Average of G-hat outcomes of a type

nodes.name: Recurrence for S
Sandwich bound for S
nodes.statement: Finally, for any $\tau_{\geq \ell}$, \begin{align} &S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \Big(\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}} \sum_{g_{\ell} \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\ell}}} \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}}\Big) \cdot S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}\nonumber\\ =~& S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot (G^{\tau_{\ell}} \cdot (I - G)^{1 - \tau_{\ell}}) \cdot S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \tag{by \Cref{eq:explicit-formula-for-G-expectation}}\\ =~& \sqrt{G^{\tau_{\ell}} \cdot (I - G)^{1 - \tau_{\ell}}} \cdot (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}})^2 \cdot \sqrt{G^{\tau_{\ell}} \cdot (I - G)^{1 - \tau_{\ell}}}\tag{because $S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}$ commutes with $G$ and $(I-G)$}\\ \leq~& \sqrt{G^{\tau_{\ell}} \cdot (I - G)^{1 - \tau_{\ell}}} \cdot I \cdot \sqrt{G^{\tau_{\ell}} \cdot (I - G)^{1 - \tau_{\ell}}} \tag{by \Cref{eq:S-bound}}\\ =~& G^{\tau_{\ell}} \cdot (I - G)^{1 - \tau_{\ell}}\nonumber\\ =~& \Big(\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}} \sum_{g_{\ell} \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\ell}}} \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}}\Big), \end{align} where the last step uses \Cref{eq:explicit-formula-for-G-expectation} again. This concludes the set of facts we will need about $S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}$.

nodes.name: Peel one G-hat factor
Move the rightmost G-hat to the second factor
nodes.statement: To start, we write $\widehat{H}$ as a sandwich of $\widehat{G}$ operators, and move the rightmost $\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}}$ to the second tensor factor. \begin{align} &\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, \ldots,g_k) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}, \dots, {\boldsymbol{x}}_{k}}_{g_{\ell}, \dots, g_{k}} \otimes S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}\ket{\psi}\nonumber\\ =~&\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, \ldots,g_k) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}}_{g_{\geq \ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}}_{g_{\geq \ell}})^\dagger) \otimes S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}\ket{\psi}\tag{by \Cref{eq:split-H-into-two-Gs}}\\ =~&\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, \ldots,g_k) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}}_{g_{\geq \ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}}) \otimes S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}\ket{\psi}\tag{by \Cref{eq:G-recurrence}}\\ \approx_{\sqrt{2\zeta}}~&\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, \ldots,g_k) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}}_{g_{\geq \ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger) \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}})\ket{\psi}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Move the rightmost G-hat to the second factor

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz
nodes.statement: To justify the approximation, we bound the error. \begin{multline} \Big|\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}}_{g_{\geq \ell}} \otimes S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}) \cdot (((\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger \otimes I) \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \otimes I - I \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} ))\ket{\psi}\Big|\\ \leq \sqrt{\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}}_{g_{\geq \ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}}_{g_{\geq \ell}})^\dagger) \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}})^2 \ket{\psi}}\\ \cdot \sqrt{\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{ (g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} ((\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \otimes I - I \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} ) \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \cdot(\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger\otimes I) \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \otimes I - I \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} ))\ket{\psi}}. \end{multline}

nodes.name: First factor at most 1
nodes.statement: The expression inside the first square root is equal to \begin{equation*} \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}}_{g_{\geq \ell}} \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}})^2 \ket{\psi}, \end{equation*} which is at most~$1$ because $S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \leq I$ and $\widehat{H}$ is a sub-measurement.

nodes.name: Second factor at most 2zeta
nodes.statement: The expression inside the second square root is equal to \begin{align*} &\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{ (g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} ((\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \otimes I - I \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} ) \cdot (\widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \otimes I) \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \otimes I - I \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} ))\ket{\psi}\\ \leq~&\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{g_{\ell}, \ldots, g_{k}} \bra{\psi} ((\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \otimes I - I \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} ) \cdot (\widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \otimes I) \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \otimes I - I \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} ))\ket{\psi}\\ \leq~& \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{g_{\ell}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \otimes I - I \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} )^2\ket{\psi} \tag{because $\widehat{H}$ is a sub-measurement}\\ \leq~& 2\zeta. \tag{by \Cref{cor:G-hat-facts}} \end{align*}

nodes.name: First commutation stage
nodes.statement: We will now commute the leftmost $\widehat{G}^{x_\ell}_{g_\ell}$ in \Cref{eq:move-g-over-there} to the right in two stages. In the first stage, we have: \begin{align} \eqref{eq:move-g-over-there} &= \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger) \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}})\ket{\psi}\nonumber\\ & \approx_{\sqrt{\nu_4}} \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger) \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}})\ket{\psi}. \end{align}

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz
nodes.statement: To justify the approximation, we bound the magnitude of the difference. \begin{multline} \Big| \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} ([ \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}}, \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell} ] \otimes I) \cdot ((\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}})^\dagger \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell})) \ket{\psi} \Big| \\ \leq \sqrt{ \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} ([ \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}}, \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell} ]) \cdot ([ \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}}, \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell} ])^\dagger \otimes I \ket{\psi}} \\ \quad \cdot \sqrt{\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}}\cdot ( \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}})^\dagger) \otimes (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell} \cdot (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}})^2 \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell}) \ket{\psi}}. \end{multline}

nodes.name: First factor at most nu_4
nodes.statement: The quantity inside the first square root is at most \begin{equation*} \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{g_{\ell}, \ldots, g_k} \bra{\psi} ([ \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}}, \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell} ]) \cdot ([ \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}}, \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell} ])^\dagger \otimes I \ket{\psi}, \end{equation*} which is at most~$\nu_4$ by~\Cref{lem:commute-g-half-sandwich}.

nodes.name: Second factor at most 1
nodes.statement: The quantity inside the second square root is equal to \begin{align*} &\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}} \otimes (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell} \cdot (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}})^2 \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell}) \ket{\psi}\\ \leq~ &\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}} \otimes (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell} \cdot I \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell}) \ket{\psi} \tag{because $S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \leq I$}\\ =~ &\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}} \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell} \ket{\psi} \\ \leq~& 1. \tag{because $\widehat{G}$ and $\widehat{H}$ are sub-measurements} \end{align*}

nodes.name: Second commutation stage
nodes.statement: We continue commuting the leftmost $\widehat{G}^{x_{\ell}}_{g_\ell}$ to the right. \begin{align} \eqref{eq:commute-g-part-one} =& \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger) \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}})\ket{\psi} \nonumber\\ \approx_{\sqrt{\nu_4}}~& \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}}) \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}})\ket{\psi}. \end{align}

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz with S
nodes.statement: To justify the approximation, we will need to be slightly more clever this time. First, as always, we bound the magnitude of the difference: \begin{multline} \Big| \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}} \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell})) \cdot ([ (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}})^\dagger, \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell} ] \otimes I) \ket{\psi} \Big|\\ \leq \sqrt{\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}})\cdot ( \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}})^\dagger \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell} \cdot S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}) \ket{\psi}} \\ \cdot \sqrt{ \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} ([ (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}})^\dagger, \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell} ])^\dagger \cdot ([ (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}})^\dagger, \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell} ]) \otimes I \ket{\psi}}. \end{multline}

nodes.name: First factor at most 1 via the S sandwich bound
nodes.statement: The term inside the first square root is equal to \begin{align*} &\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}} \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell} \cdot S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}) \ket{\psi}\\ =~&\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{g_{>\ell} \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{> \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}} \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \Big(\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}} \sum_{g_{\ell} \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\ell}}}\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell} \Big)\cdot S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}) \ket{\psi}\\ \leq~&\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{g_{>\ell} \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{> \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}} \otimes \Big(\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}} \sum_{g_{\ell} \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\ell}}}\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell} \Big) \ket{\psi} \tag{by~\Cref{eq:S-sandwich}}\\ =~&\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{>\ell}}_{g_{>\ell}} \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_\ell} \ket{\psi}\\ \leq~& 1. \tag{because $\widehat{G}$ and $\widehat{H}$ are sub-measurements} \end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: First factor at most 1 via the S sandwich bound

nodes.name: Second factor at most nu_4
nodes.statement: The term inside the second square root is equal to the term inside the first square root of~\Cref{eq:call-this-later}, which we bounded by~$\nu_4$.

nodes.name: Move the leftmost G-hat to the second factor
nodes.statement: We are now ready for the final step, which is to bring the leftmost $\widehat{G}^{x_\ell}_{g_\ell}$ over to the second tensor factor. \begin{align} \eqref{eq:commute-g-part-two} &= \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}}) \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}})\ket{\psi}\nonumber\\ &\approx_{\sqrt{2\zeta}} \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger) \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}}\cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}})\ket{\psi}. \end{align}
nodes.statement_short: Move the leftmost G-hat to the second factor

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz
nodes.statement: To justify the approximation, we bound the magnitude of the difference. \begin{multline*} \Big|\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}})) \cdot (((\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger \otimes I) \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \otimes I - I \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}}))\ket{\psi} \Big| \\ \leq \sqrt{\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}}\sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger) \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}} \cdot S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}) \ket{\psi}} \nonumber \\ \cdot \sqrt{\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} ( (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell} \otimes I - I \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell})\cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger \otimes I) \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell} \otimes I - I \otimes \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_\ell}_{g_\ell})). \ket{\psi}} \end{multline*}

nodes.name: Bound both factors
nodes.statement: The expression inside the first is equal to the expression inside the first square root in~\Cref{eq:call-again-later-part-dos}, which we bounded by~$1$.

nodes.name: Second factor at most 2zeta
nodes.statement: The expression inside the second square root is equal to the expression inside the second square root in~\Cref{eq:call-again-later-part-tres}, which we bounded by~$2\zeta$.

nodes.name: Apply the S recurrence
nodes.statement: We end by noting that \begin{align*} \eqref{eq:h-ot-mgg} & = \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \cdot (\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}})^\dagger) \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}})\ket{\psi} \tag{because $\widehat{G}$ is projective}\\ & = \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \sum_{(g_{\ell}, g_{>\ell}) \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\geq \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \otimes (S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}})\ket{\psi}\\ & =\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{> \ell}} \sum_{g_{>\ell} \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{> \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \otimes \Big(\sum_{\tau_{\ell}}S_{\tau_{\geq \ell}} \cdot \Big(\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}} \sum_{g_\ell \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{\ell}}}\widehat{G}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\ell}}_{g_{\ell}}\Big)\Big)\ket{\psi}\\ & =\mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}} \sum_{\tau_{> \ell}} \sum_{g_{>\ell} \in \mathsf{O}_{\tau_{> \ell}}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_{> \ell}}_{g_{> \ell}} \otimes S_{\tau_{>\ell}}\ket{\psi}. \tag{by \Cref{eq:S-recurrence}} \end{align*} This concludes the proof of \Cref{eq:i-think-this-is-what-i'm-supposed-to-prove-2} and therefore proves the lemma.

nodes.name: Eigenvalue distribution mu
nodes.statement: Let $\rho$ be the reduced state of $\ket{\psi}$ on one prover's subsystem (since the state is assumed to be symmetric, it does not matter which prover we take). Write the eigendecomposition $X = \sum_{i} \lambda_i \ket{v_i}\bra{v_i}$ of $X$, where we allow some of the eigenvalues to be $0$ so that the set of eigenvectors $\{\ket{v_i}\}$ forms an orthonormal basis of the space. This defines a probability distribution $\mu$ over eigenvectors, where eigenvector $i$ occurs with probability $\mu(i) = \bra{v_i} \rho \ket{v_i}$.

nodes.name: Average eigenvalue at least 1-kappa
nodes.statement: The given condition $\bra{\psi} X \otimes I \ket{\psi} = \mathrm{tr}(X \rho) \geq 1 -\kappa$ implies that \begin{align*} \mathop{\bf E\/}_{\boldsymbol{i} \sim \mu} \lambda_{\boldsymbol{i}} = \sum_i \lambda_i \cdot \mu(i) &= \sum_i \lambda_i \cdot \bra{v_i} \rho \ket{v_i}\\ &=\sum_i \lambda_i \cdot \mathrm{tr}(\ket{v_i} \bra{v_i} \cdot \rho)\\ &=\mathrm{tr} \Big(\sum_i \lambda_i \ket{v_i} \bra{v_i} \cdot\rho\Big) = \mathrm{tr}(X \rho) \geq 1 - \kappa. \end{align*} Or, equivalently, \begin{equation*} \mathop{\bf E\/}_{\boldsymbol{i} \sim \mu} ( 1 -\lambda_{\boldsymbol{i}}) \leq \kappa. \end{equation*}

nodes.name: Most mass on eigenvalues above theta
nodes.statement: By Markov's inequality, for any $0 < \theta < 1$, we have \begin{equation*} \mathop{\bf Pr\/}_{\boldsymbol{i} \sim \mu}[(1-\lambda_{\boldsymbol{i}}) \geq (1 - \theta)] \leq \frac{\mathop{\bf E\/}_{\boldsymbol{i} \sim \mu} (1-\lambda_{\boldsymbol{i}})}{1-\theta} \leq \frac{\kappa}{1-\theta}. \end{equation*} In other words, \begin{equation} \mathop{\bf Pr\/}_{\boldsymbol{i} \sim \mu}[\lambda_{\boldsymbol{i}} > \theta] = \mathop{\bf Pr\/}_{\boldsymbol{i} \sim \mu}[(1 - \lambda_{\boldsymbol{i}}) < (1 - \theta)] = 1 - \mathop{\bf Pr\/}_{\boldsymbol{i} \sim \mu}[(1 - \lambda_{\boldsymbol{i}}) \geq (1 - \theta)] \geq 1 - \frac{\kappa}{1-\theta}. \end{equation} Thus, it holds that with probability at least $1 - \frac{\kappa}{1 - \theta}$ over $\boldsymbol{i} \sim \mu$, $\lambda_{\boldsymbol{i}} > \theta$.
nodes.statement_short: Most mass on eigenvalues above theta

nodes.name: Evaluate eigenvalue by eigenvalue
nodes.statement: We now evaluate $\bra{\psi} F(X) \otimes I \ket{\psi}$. We will essentially do this eigenvalue by eigenvalue.

nodes.name: F(p) is a binomial tail
nodes.statement: To begin, we consider a hypothetical eigenvalue $d/k \leq p \leq 1$. Observe that $F(p)$ is precisely the probability probability of observing at least $d+1$ successes out of $k$ i.i.d.\ Bernoulli trials, each of which succeeds with probability $p$. In other words, it is the probability that $\boldsymbol{Y} := \boldsymbol{Y}_1 + \cdots + \boldsymbol{Y}_k \geq d+1$, where $\boldsymbol{Y}_1, \ldots, \boldsymbol{Y}_k \sim \mathrm{Bernoulli}(p)$.

nodes.name: Chernoff bound
nodes.statement: We can bound this probability by the additive Chernoff bound (see the second additive bound in~\cite{Blu11}): \begin{align*} \mathop{\bf Pr\/}[\boldsymbol{Y} \leq d] &= \mathop{\bf Pr\/}[\boldsymbol{Y} \leq p k - (pk - d)] \\ &=\mathop{\bf Pr\/}\Big[\boldsymbol{Y} \leq pk - \Big(p - \frac{d}{k}\Big)\cdot k\Big]\\ &\leq \exp\Big(-2 \Big(p - \frac{d}{k}\Big)^2 \cdot k\Big). \end{align*} Thus, \begin{equation} F(p) = \mathop{\bf Pr\/}[\boldsymbol{Y} \geq d+1] = 1 - \mathop{\bf Pr\/}[\boldsymbol{Y} \leq d] \geq 1 - \exp\Big(-2 \Big(p - \frac{d}{k}\Big)^2 \cdot k\Big). \end{equation}

nodes.statement:
Putting the pieces together, we compute $ ra{\psi} f(X) \otimes I \ket{\psi}$:  egin{align}  ra{\psi} F(X) \otimes I \ket{\psi} &= \mathrm{tr}(F(X) ho)

nodes.name: Elementary inequality
nodes.statement: Next, we claim that if $a, b, c \geq 0$ satisfy $a \geq (1-b) \cdot (1-c)$, then $a \geq 1 - b - c$. This is because if either $b$ or $c$ is at least~$1$, then the conclusion is trivially true, and if both are less than~$1$, then \begin{equation*} (1-b) \cdot (1-c) = 1\cdot (1-c) - b \cdot (1-c) \geq 1 \cdot (1-c) - b \cdot 1 = 1-c-b. \end{equation*}

nodes.name: Apply it
nodes.statement: Since $\bra{\psi} F(X) \otimes I \ket{\psi}$ is manifestly positive, we can apply this to \Cref{eq:almost-done-with-this-giant-proof}, yielding \begin{equation*} \bra{\psi} F(X) \otimes I \ket{\psi} \geq 1 - \frac{\kappa}{1 - \theta} - \exp \Big(-2\Big(\theta - \frac{d}{k}\Big)^2 \cdot k \Big). \end{equation*}

nodes.name: Simplify the exponent
nodes.statement: Finally, we note that because $k \geq 2d/\theta$, we have $\theta/2 \geq d/k$. This implies that $\theta-d/k \geq \theta - \theta/2 = \theta/2$, and so $(\theta - d/k)^2 \geq (\theta/2)^2 = \theta^2/4$. As a result, \begin{equation*} \exp \Big(2\Big(\theta - \frac{d}{k}\Big)^2 \cdot k \Big) \geq \exp \Big(\theta^2 k/2 \Big). \end{equation*} Equivalently, \begin{equation*} \exp \Big(-2\Big(\theta - \frac{d}{k}\Big)^2 \cdot k \Big) \leq \exp \Big(-\theta^2 k/2 \Big). \end{equation*} Thus, we conclude \begin{equation*} \bra{\psi} F(X) \otimes I \ket{\psi} \geq 1 - \frac{\kappa}{1 - \theta} - \exp \Big(-\theta^2 k/2 \Big).\qedhere \end{equation*}

nodes.name: Reduce to F(G)
nodes.statement: We begin by approximating the completeness as follows. \begin{align*} \bra{\psi} H \otimes I \ket{\psi} & \approx_{\nu_7} \mathop{\bf E\/}_{{\boldsymbol{x}}_1, \ldots, {\boldsymbol{x}}_k} \sum_{\tau:|\tau| \geq d+1} \sum_{(g_1, \ldots, g_k) \in \mathsf{Outcomes}_{\tau}} \bra{\psi} \widehat{H}^{{\boldsymbol{x}}_1, \ldots, {\boldsymbol{x}}_k}_{g_1, \ldots, g_k} \otimes I \ket{\psi} \tag{by \Cref{lem:over-all-outcomes}}\\ & \approx_{\nu_8} \sum_{i = d+1}^k \binom{k}{i} \bra{\psi} G^i (I-G)^{k-i} \otimes I \ket{\psi} \tag{by \Cref{lem:from-H-to-G}}\\ & = \bra{\psi} F(G) \otimes I \ket{\psi}. \end{align*}

nodes.name: Errors at most nu
Choose theta
nodes.statement: Let $\theta = 1/(200 m)$. Note that \begin{equation*} \frac{1}{1-\theta} = \frac{1}{1- 1/(200m)} = \frac{200m}{200m-1} = 1 + \frac{1}{200m-1} \leq 1 + \frac{1}{100m}. \end{equation*} Then $k \geq 2d/\theta$ and, therefore, $k \geq d+1$. As a result, $k$ and~$\theta$ satisfy the hypothesis of \Cref{lem:chernoff-bernoulli-matrix}, namely that $k \geq \max\{d+1, 2d/\theta\}$.

nodes.name: Apply the Chernoff lemma
nodes.statement: Thus, \Cref{lem:chernoff-bernoulli-matrix} implies that \begin{align*} \bra{\psi} F(G) \otimes I \ket{\psi} &\geq 1 - \frac{\kappa}{1 - \theta} - e^{-\theta^2 k/2}\\ &= 1 - \frac{\kappa}{1 - \theta} - e^{- k/(80000m^2)}\\ &\geq 1 - \kappa \cdot \left(1 + \frac{1}{100m}\right) - e^{- k/(80000m^2)}. \end{align*}

nodes.name: Conclude
nodes.statement: In total, we have \begin{equation*} \bra{\psi} H \otimes I \ket{\psi} \geq 1 - \kappa \cdot \left(1 + \frac{1}{100m}\right) - \nu - e^{- k/(80000m^2)}. \end{equation*} This completes the proof.
